standard.summary: 训练图片的目标分辨率。分辨率越高模型学到的细节越多，但显存占用和训练时间也显著增加。是除训练步数外最影响训练成本和效果的参数。
standard.effect: SDXL 推荐 1024（匹配底模训练分辨率）；SD1.5 推荐 512。支持 '1024,768' 格式指定非正方形分辨率。分辨率翻倍，latent 面积翻 4 倍，显存约翻 4 倍，训练时间约翻 4 倍（UNet forward 与空间面积成正比）。
standard.whenToUse: 匹配底模训练分辨率是最佳实践。如果显存不足，优先开 gradient_checkpointing + cache_latents 而不是降分辨率——降分辨率会丢失高频信息，模型无法学到细节。
standard.avoidWhen: 不要在 16GB 以下显存跑 SDXL 2048——即使开了所有显存优化也很难稳定训练。enable_mixed_resolution_training 可以在同一训练中混合多个分辨率阶段（前期 512 后期 1024），兼顾速度和细节。

standard_en.summary: The target resolution of the training images. The higher it is the more detail the model learns, but VRAM use and training time rise markedly too. After the step count, this is the parameter that affects training cost and results most.
standard_en.effect: 1024 is recommended for SDXL (matching the base model's training resolution); 512 for SD1.5. A '1024,768' form is supported for non-square resolutions. Double the resolution and the latent area quadruples, so VRAM roughly quadruples and training time roughly quadruples (the UNet forward pass is proportional to spatial area).
standard_en.whenToUse: Matching the base model's training resolution is the best practice. If VRAM is short, turn on gradient_checkpointing + cache_latents before you lower the resolution -- lowering it throws away high-frequency information and the model cannot learn the detail.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not run SDXL at 2048 on under 16GB -- even with every VRAM optimisation on it is hard to train stably. enable_mixed_resolution_training can mix several resolution stages in one run (512 early, 1024 later), balancing speed against detail.

recommendedValues.sdxl: 1024 (the base model's training resolution, strongly recommended)

advanced.principle: 分辨率 → VAE encode → latent 空间维度。SDXL VAE 下采样 8 倍：1024px → 128×128 latent（4 channels × 128 × 128 = 65536 元素）。UNet forward 的 attention 计算是 O(n²)，n = latent 面积 = (resolution/8)²。所以分辨率从 1024→2048，attention 计算量翻 16 倍（不是 4 倍）。Flash Attention 将 attention 从 O(n²) 降到 O(n)，所以高分辨率时 Flash2/SageAttn 的收益更大。
advanced.intervention: resolution 传入 DataLoader 的 resize target 和 BucketManager 的面积基准。VAE encode 输出的 latent shape 直接取决于输入分辨率。staged_resolution 在训练过程中动态切换分辨率——例如前 500 步用 512 快速学构图，后 1500 步用 1024 学细节。
advanced.expectedImpact: 高分辨率对纹理细节（皮肤、织物、毛发）影响最大。SDXL 在 512px 训练的 LoRA 生成 1024px 图像时会出现重复纹理和模糊。对构图和色彩的影响较小——这些在低分辨率也能学好。
advanced.tradeoffs: staged_resolution_steps 和 staged_resolution_values 控制阶段分辨率训练。例如 '500,1500' + '512,1024' 表示前 500 步 512px，后 1500 步 1024px。staged_resolution_ratio_* 系列参数按面积比例控制。这比固定分辨率节省约 20-30% 训练时间且质量接近。
advanced.codePath: dataset_loader.py:resize/crop → VAE encode → latent (C, H/8, W/8) → UNet forward

advanced_en.principle: Resolution → VAE encode → latent space dimensions. The SDXL VAE downsamples 8x: 1024px → 128×128 latent (4 channels × 128 × 128 = 65536 elements). The UNet forward's attention compute is O(n²) with n = latent area = (resolution/8)². So going 1024→2048 multiplies attention compute 16-fold (not 4-fold). Flash Attention reduces attention from O(n²) to O(n), so Flash2/SageAttn benefit more at high resolution.
advanced_en.intervention: resolution feeds the DataLoader's resize target and the BucketManager's area baseline. The VAE encode output's latent shape depends directly on input resolution. staged_resolution switches resolution dynamically during training — e.g. the first 500 steps at 512 to learn composition quickly, then 1500 steps at 1024 to learn detail.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: High resolution matters most for texture detail (skin, fabric, hair). A LoRA trained at 512px on SDXL shows repeating textures and blur when generating 1024px images. Effects on composition and color are smaller — those are learnable at low resolution too.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: staged_resolution_steps and staged_resolution_values control staged-resolution training, e.g. '500,1500' + '512,1024' means the first 500 steps at 512px then 1500 steps at 1024px. The staged_resolution_ratio_* parameters control it by area ratio. This saves about 20-30% training time versus fixed resolution at near-identical quality.
advanced_en.codePath: dataset_loader.py:resize/crop → VAE encode → latent (C, H/8, W/8) → UNet forward
